description: Road vehicles Australia, is a series of datasets listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bureau of Infrastructure and Transport Research Economics. Selected confidentialised extracts of the number of vehicles registered for road use in Australia on 31 January 2025. The statistics have been derived from state and territory motor vehicle registry data. These statistics replace the ABS Motor Vehicle Census, discontinued in 2021. Disclaimers:. Coverage: Australia. The portal lists 5 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Bureau of Infrastructure and Transport Research Economics. Its tags are Australia, BITRE, postcodes, registrations, road. It offers 18 resource(s) in CSV, TXT. The portal shows 2025-10-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
